notes: Public documented API, no auth, no User-Agent restrictions; pagination cap is 100 per page (totalFound/offset/limit envelope).
location.country is a LOWERCASE ISO alpha-2 code ('za', 'im', 'ng') — uppercase it directly, no name mapping needed.
postedDate: use the date part of releasedDate (full ISO timestamp).
applyUrl is the official apply deep link (jobs.smartrecruiters.com/StandardBankGroup/...); postingUrl is the posting page.
Description HTML lives in jobAd.sections.{companyDescription, jobDescription, qualifications, additionalInformation} — each {title, text}. companyDescription is generic bank boilerplate.
typeOfEmployment: {id: 'permanent', label: 'Full-time'} — use the label; Part-time postings exist.
function/department labels are mostly 'Other' — categorize from the title.
